reply.rationale: No defensible compositional paradigm survives the evidence requirements. The suggested surface families ('Cor', '-ll', '-ft') do not show stable shared meanings with substitutable residues in a common frame; they are best treated as accidental string overlap. The standalone face symbols (L, R, T, B, F, Bk) and intensity symbols (lo, mod, hi) do form semantic sets, but there are no attested multi-morpheme codes in this codebook where they recur as productive slots inside larger symbols, so they cannot license entries, classes, or constructions on their own. Other items such as S:, R:, DX:, and DO: are standalone labels, but no supplied symbols instantiate larger composed forms using them. Therefore the safest complete partition is a flat lexicon with every supplied symbol opaque.
